restoration_note: Teaching describes three divine emanations grieving over the captive Living Soul: Mother of Life mourning her children mingled with Darkness and bound in the archonic host; First Man mourning his Five Sons in the Vessel of Light; and a third (broken off, likely Living Spirit). Most gaps are short orthographic completions (verb morphology, prepositions, ordinals, names) tightly constrained by surrounding traces and the Coptic grammar of grief-formulas (ⲣ̄ⲗⲩⲡⲏ, ⲣ̄ϩⲏⲃⲉ, ⲙⲟⲩϩ ⲛ̄ⲥⲱ⸗, ⲙⲁⲕϩ ⲛ̄ϩⲏⲧ). All editor restorations confirmed; only {7} retains residual uncertainty for an 8-character secondary lacuna whose precise content cannot be recovered, but the immediate continuation ⲁⲓ̈ⲛⲉ ('Light' completing 'Vessel of Light') is fixed.

restorations.basis: Trace ⲟⲩ following yields ⲙⲉⲧⲟⲩ 'poison'. Manichaean cosmological triad of mingling: Darkness + Poison + bondage in the archonic host. Confirms editor.
Trace ⲩϩ ⲛ̄ⲥⲱⲩ requires ⲙⲟⲩϩ ⲛ̄ⲥⲱ⸗ idiom 'be filled with longing for'. Maternal longing of Mother of Life for her captive children fits the grief-arc.
Trace ⲉⲩ ⲁⲣⲁⲩ requires ⲛⲉⲩ/ⲥⲛⲁⲩ 'see them'; Lycopolitan 3sg.f. ⲥ-ⲛⲉⲩ. The Mother sees her children in suffering and grieves.
Standard verb ⲣ̄ϩⲏⲃⲉ 'mourn', completed by final ⲉ. Paired here with ⲣ̄ⲗⲩⲡⲏ 'grieve' as the standard grief-mourning doublet.

Trace ϩⲥⲛⲉⲩ yields feminine ordinal ⲧⲧⲙⲁϩⲥⲛⲉⲩ 'the second one'. Structurally required: enumeration follows 'the first who grieves is the Mother of Life' and precedes 'the third one who grieves' in line 20.
Standard formula ⲙⲁⲕϩ ⲛ̄ϩⲏⲧ 'grieved in heart' (cf. line 12 ϥⲙⲁⲕϩ ⲛϩⲏⲧ of First Man). Single-letter preposition ⲛ̄.
Trace ⲁⲟ̄ + paired ⲙⲛ̄ ⲧⲉϥⲙⲛ̄ⲧⲣⲣⲟ requires ⲧⲉϥⲙⲛ̄ⲧⲛⲁⲟ̄ 'his Greatness'. Standard cosmological pairing 'Greatness + Kingship' belongs to the First Man, established in the Vessel of Light.

Continues ⲡⲧⲭⲁⲓ̈ ⲛⲟⲩ- from prior line into ⲟⲩⲁⲓ̈ⲛⲉ 'Vessel of Light' = sun-ship/luminary-vessel of First Man. An additional ~8-char lacuna follows whose precise content is irrecoverable; only the high-confidence completion of 'Light' is offered.
Trace ⲛ_ⲡⲏ requires Greek loanword ⲗⲩⲡⲏ 'grief', the standard term paired here with native ϩⲏⲃⲉ 'mourning' (ϣⲁϩⲃⲓ ⲛ̄ⲗⲩⲡⲏ ϩⲓ ϩⲏⲃⲉ).
Trace _ⲏ_ⲉ with following context ⲉⲧⲃⲉ ⲛⲉϩ- 'on account of his...' requires ϣⲏⲣⲉ 'sons'. Refers to the Five Sons of the First Man.
Middle consonant of ϣⲏⲣⲉ 'sons', completing the genitive phrase ⲉⲧⲃⲉ ⲛⲉϩϣⲏⲣⲉ 'on account of his sons'.
